fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) faces €880M fine in Italy for unauthorized access to photos and metadata, with the Gallery Suggestions feature accused of processing images without explicit user consent.
fields.summary_ko.1: Regulatory risk is directly linked to Meta's AI-driven advertising expansion and $130–145B capital expenditure plan for 2026, with stricter data-use regulations potentially pressuring AI performance and profitability.
